licence.scope: Outreach-site licence of NOIRLab (owner of Kitt Peak National Observatory), the owner's website terms (step 2); followed sibling KPNO__Mosaic. The sentence reads '...not released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License and can not be used for non-NOIRLab products.'; it is quoted in two parts because the page has non-breaking-space markup between them. The filter pages carry no statement on the curve files. Source page SVO cites: ftp://ftp.noao.edu/kpno/filters/4Inch_List.html; the host does not resolve (curl exit 6, 2026-10-26), so no statement could be read there. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
